The '''Wellte-ir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bresnan]].<ref name="AJ11" />
